people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Jair
people.line: An Israelite who possessed towns in Gilead

people.name: Mahanaim
people.line: A place east of the Jordan; David's refuge

people.name: Og
people.line: King of Bashan, defeated by Israel

translations.web: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the villages of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
translations.bsb: The territory from Mahanaim through all Bashan—all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, including all the towns of Jair that are in Bashan, sixty cities;
translations.kjv: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
